description: This file contains helper functions for launching code editors from a development environment, including platform-specific logic for different editors and operating systems, as well as security checks and user instructions.

methods.name: isTerminalEditor
methods.description: Determines if the given editor is a terminal-based editor.

methods.name: getArgumentsForLineNumber
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for opening a file at a specific line and column in various editors.

methods.name: guessEditor
methods.description: Attempts to detect the currently running editor based on environment variables and active processes.

methods.name: printInstructions
methods.description: Displays user instructions and error messages related to launching editors.

methods.name: launchEditor
methods.description: Main function to open a file in an editor at a specified line and column, with platform-specific handling and security checks.
